args: set -euo pipefail; curl -sS -m 30 https://model-tier-drop-mcp.bradheitmann.ai/mcp -H 'content-type: application/json' -H 'accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/list"}' | jq -e '.result.tools | length == 13'

evidence_required: The live tools/list count, the live tools/call adjacent result and the Slice Zero output.
objective: Deploy the Worker from the V-10-accepted S-10 tip and record the live checks, before S-10 merges to main.

outputs.purpose: The deployment record for the adjacent tool.

risk_controls: The deploy happens only from the V-10-accepted tip, before S-10 merges to main.
Credentials come from the environment and are never written to disk or the repository; identifiers are redacted in the record.
Rust only; no Python and no authored JavaScript files.
No secret, phone number, account identifier or internal hostname in any file.
Never write the owner's forbidden organisation name (grep pattern O[K]OA) or the forbidden phrase (grep pattern needs[ ]you).
wrangler rollback returns to the deployment recorded in S-06.
rollback: wrangler rollback to the previous deployment (recorded in S-06).
steps: Deploy the Worker from the V-10-accepted S-10 tip (wrangler deploy as in S-06), BEFORE S-10 merges to main: the deployed Worker rejects unknown fields, so the Slice Zero test (crates/cli/tests/slice_zero.rs) fails between a merge that adds lineage to the example registry and the deploy.
Record the deployment id and the live checks in crates/worker/README.md.
